os_list.name: Omarchy Quattro v2.0 - Arch Linux ARM (Pi 5 NVMe)
os_list.description: Definitive v2.0 release image with 100% Omarchy v4.0.3 parity on Raspberry Pi 5. Features Hyprland 0.56.2 on Wayland with Aquamarine & Quickshell, Walker launcher, Tokyo Night theme, 16k kernel, PCIe Gen 3 NVMe tuning, Argon active cooling, self-updating architecture, and complete AI agent suite (OpenClaw, Hermes, Cursor CLI, Muse Code, Claude, Codex, Copilot, ChatGPT, Perplexity, VS Code).

subitems.name: Omarchy Quattro v2.0 (Zstandard — Hyprland + Full 4.0.3 AI Suite)
subitems.description: Boots straight to Hyprland 0.56.2 desktop with Walker launcher, Tokyo Night theme, btop, Chromium, and complete Omarchy v4.0.3 AI suite (OpenClaw, Hermes, Cursor CLI).
